recap.analyst:
Coloso Ciudad beat Montaña CF 2-1. On expected goals it finished 0.42–0.74: the scoreline flatters Coloso Ciudad, who were second-best on chance quality.

Montaña CF had 65% of the ball. Pass completion COL 67% (83/123), MON 85% (230/270). Shots 5–6, on target 1–0.

Coloso Ciudad started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Montaña CF in a 5-4-1 (direct). In-game changes: MON to 3-4-3 at 68' (chasing the game); COL to 5-4-1 at 83' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 12': An own goal by K. Uribe The chance was worth xG 0.05 (about 5 in 100 go in), struck at 98 km/h. Score now COL 1-1 MON.

By the numbers: V. Ramos completed the most passes (46); R. Guerreiro hit the top speed (31.8 km/h); Z. Bauer covered the most ground (6.22 km, a 17.3 km per-90 pace); D. Weiss won the most challenges (15).

Discipline: fouls 5–5, yellows 1–1, offsides 0–0. Conditions: rain, 22°C, pitch wet, quick.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Estadio Coloso, Mexico City, with the rain adding to the drama. An own goal opened the scoring in the 3rd minute, and Montaña CF were ahead. Then an own goal in the 12th gave Coloso Ciudad another. Y. Ulloa struck in the 40th for Coloso Ciudad. Montaña CF pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 68th minute, but Coloso Ciudad held firm. The hero: Y. Ulloa, with the goal that mattered. At the final whistle, Coloso Ciudad celebrate in front of their fans.
